query: select tablename,indexname,indexdef from pg_indexes where schemaname='public' and tablename in ('loyalty_history','reward_transactions','progression_events','progression_claims') and indexdef ilike '%unique%' order by tablename,indexname;

data.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX loyalty_history_pkey ON public.loyalty_history USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX progression_claims_pkey ON public.progression_claims USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX progression_claims_user_id_claim_group_evidence_key_key ON public.progression_claims USING btree (user_id, claim_group, evidence_key)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX progression_events_idempotency_key_key ON public.progression_events USING btree (idempotency_key)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX progression_events_pkey ON public.progression_events USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX progression_events_reward_transaction_id_key ON public.progression_events USING btree (reward_transaction_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX reward_transactions_pkey ON public.reward_transactions USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_reward_transactions_idempotency ON public.reward_transactions USING btree (idempotency_key) WHERE (idempotency_key IS NOT NULL)
